# AI Knowledge Base

> A reference for choosing and building with AI: models, concepts, setup, deployment, and practical scenarios.

Generated by `python build_index.py`; do not edit by hand.
Read the full topic before using its guidance. Check last_verified and official sources for volatile facts; stable is not a freshness guarantee.

## Start here

- [Topic index](INDEX.md): All topics with tags, use cases, status, and verification dates.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): How to consult and extend this knowledge base.
- [Repository overview](README.md): Layout and local browsing tools.
